name: Female Desperate Vol.6
source:
This is #6 of the series that depicts women's urge to go
to the bathroom created by a real fan of the genre. Contains 3 episodes.

The urge to pee hits a female detective during a long stake-out.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE264036.html]DLsite English[/url]]

描繪女性如廁窘境的系列第六作，由一位真正熱愛這一題材的作者創作。本作收錄三個故事。

一位女偵探在長時間埋伏監視時，突然感到尿急。
